landing_context.context_cutoff_note: Evening of Round 1 (2023-04-27). The Lamar Jackson extension was announced hours before Round 1 and is therefore inside the cutoff. No Day 2/3 picks or later moves are admitted.

returning_receiver_depth_chart.status_at_cutoff: Signed 1-year, ~$15M guaranteed deal 2023-04-13; did not play in 2022 (ACL recovery); age 30; expected starter if healthy.
Returning 2021 R1 pick; season-ending Lisfranc surgery in 2022; recovery status uncertain at cutoff.

returning_tight_end_depth_chart.status_at_cutoff: Returning; unquestioned target-share leader and Jackson's primary read.
Departed in free agency (signed elsewhere March 2023).

vacated_targets.season_basis: 2022 REG targets of pass catchers verifiably gone by cutoff: Demarcus Robinson 75 (unsigned UFA at cutoff), Sammy Watkins 27, DeSean Jackson 17, Kenyan Drake 26. Josh Oliver's 25 TE targets additionally departed (flagged needs_verification on exact timing).
vacated_targets.needs_verification_note: Demarcus Robinson was not verifiably signed elsewhere before the draft; treated as vacated with medium confidence. Watkins/Jackson/Drake departures were standard expiring-veteran non-retentions.
vacated_targets.volume_caveat: Vacancy is measured against the NFL's lowest-volume 2022 pass offense (492 team targets); raw vacated targets overstate opportunity unless pass volume rose.

vacated_routes_or_snaps.note: Route/snap data unavailable for 2022 (no governed source; upstream nulls by design).

quarterback_state.status_at_cutoff: Signed a 5-year, $260M extension announced 2023-04-27, hours before Round 1, ending a trade-request standoff (request made 2023-03-02, non-exclusive franchise tag applied). QB stability restored inside the cutoff window.
quarterback_state.style_note: Elite dual-threat; historically supports concentrated TE volume and a sub-median team target total.

coaching_and_scheme_state.offensive_coordinator: Todd Monken, hired 2023-02-14 replacing Greg Roman (resigned Jan 2023)

expected_change_inference.read: Monken's Georgia/NFL background signaled a modernization away from Roman's run-first structure: more 11 personnel, more dropback pass volume, more WR-friendly target distribution.

prior_season_offense_quality.qualitative: Run-heavy, bottom-of-league pass volume; competent scoring when Jackson healthy but he missed the final five-plus games of 2022 (knee). Pass-catcher room outside Andrews was among the league's least productive.

projected_role_openings.role: Immediate starting slot/Z with first-round capital commitment; clear WR1-of-the-future positioning given no incumbent young WR had secured a role
Target ceiling gated by Andrews' established share and OBJ's guaranteed money

role_competition.basis: target-share leader; QB's trusted first read
$15M guaranteed veteran; snap and target claim if healthy

opportunity_interpretation.read: Medium-favorable. First-round capital plus a genuinely vacated WR room and an announced scheme modernization created a credible immediate-role case; but the room was crowded with veteran capital (OBJ, Agholor), Andrews dominated the target hierarchy, and the franchise's structural pass-volume history was the lowest in the league. Round-1 capital was sufficient for the role, not sufficient for early elite volume.
contingencies: Monken actually raising pass volume from Roman-era floor
OBJ/Bateman health outcomes redistributing perimeter snaps
Jackson playing a full season under the new deal

limitations: No governed April 2023 depth-chart snapshot; ordering derived from 2022 usage plus verified signings.
Josh Oliver and Demarcus Robinson departure timing not independently re-verified.
Jackson 2022 availability details recalled from public record, not re-verified.
Governed 2022 team-environment data (pace, PROE, EPA) does not exist in any TIBER repo.

source_lineage.provides: Bateman Lisfranc detail, Oliver departure, Jackson 2022 injury detail

hindsight_exclusion_note: Nothing after the evening of 2023-04-27 is admitted: no Day 2/3 draft picks, no OBJ/Bateman 2023 season outcomes, no Monken-era actual pass-rate data, and no NFL production of any 2023 draftee.
